description: BattleBall on Sky Peak (map 1, no power ups): a spectator (WATCHGAME during the game, GAMELOCATION, YOUARESPECTATOR and GAMESTART on G_STAT, the game's messages), a game the same-IP check leaves unscored, GAMERESTART by both players (PLAYERREJOINED, GAMERESET, FULLGAMESTATUS, a new game id, the spectator sent to the lobby), the second game, then GAMERESTART by one player only: when the countdown ends both go back to the lobby (ROOMFORWARD) and the game is gone
